subject: pe
title: Training to Raise VO2 Max
welcome_lead: Continuous, interval, fartlek, HIIT — methods to lift aerobic capacity.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on aerobic training methods and physiological adaptations.
final_note: HIIT delivers VO₂max gains in a fraction of continuous-training time — but recovery matters.

concepts.def: Steady-state aerobic work at moderate intensity, ≥20 min.
Swedish for 'speed play'; unstructured continuous-interval blend.
Loss of adaptations within 2–4 weeks of stopping training.

walkthroughs.body_html: Continuous develops base aerobic capacity. Intervals add high-intensity stress that raises VO₂max faster.
Endurance training raises SV (LV hypertrophy), capillary density and mitochondrial volume.
4 × 4-min @ 90% HRmax with 3-min recovery (Norwegian protocol) raises VO₂max in untrained by ~10% in 8 weeks.
